issue_context.title: Build fails when postcss config is declared in package.json
issue_context.body:
# 🐛 bug report

Build fails with parcel v2 when postcss config is declared in `package.json`. Using `postcss.config.js` however works just fine.

## 🎛 Configuration (.babelrc, package.json, cli command)

```js
// package.json
{

  ...

  "devDependencies": {
    "autoprefixer": "^9.7.6",
    "parcel": "^2.0.0-alpha.3.2",
    "tailwindcss": "^1.4.5"
    ...
  },
  "browserslist": [
    "defaults"
  ],
  "postcss": {
    "plugins": {
      "autoprefixer": {},
      "tailwindcss": {}
    }
  },

  ...

}
```

## 🤔 Expected Behavior

This works with `parcel@1.12.4` so my expectation was that it'd work with `parcel@next` (but I'm not sure whether or not it actually _should_).

## 😯 Current Behavior

```js
🚨 Build failed.
@parcel/transformer-postcss: conf.files is not iterable
TypeError: conf.files is not iterable
    at UncommittedAsset.getConfig (/path/to/project/node_modules/@parcel/core/lib/UncommittedAsset.js:315:27)
    at async Object.getConfig (/path/to/project/node_modules/@parcel/transformer-postcss/lib/PostCSSTransformer.js:38:22)
    at async runTransformer (/path/to/project/node_modules/@parcel/core/lib/Transformation.js:443:14)
    at async Transformation.runPipeline (/path/to/project/node_modules/@parcel/core/lib/Transformation.js:257:36)
    at async Transformation.runPipelines (/path/to/project/node_modules/@parcel/core/lib/Transformation.js:193:40)
    at async Transformation.run (/path/to/project/node_modules/@parcel/core/lib/Transformation.js:111:19)
    at async Child.handleRequest (/path/to/project/node_modules/@parcel/workers/lib/child.js:165:9)
```

## 🌍 Your Environment

| Software         | Version(s) |
| ---------------- | ---------- |
| Parcel           | 2.0.0-alpha.3.2 and 2.0.0-nightly.261
| Node             | v12.16.3
| npm/Yarn         | v6.14.5
| Operating System | ubuntu 18.04 (WSL v1)

review_comments:
Should `files` be "source files for the config result" or "files that will need to be added as included files"?
For the former, we'd have to return the package.json path (`getPackage()` returns only the result) as well.
